settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS; never change face, skin, hair, outfit, props, age or relative height.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous flood-escape scenes. Water level, raft state, opened doors and carried props persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP04 — เมืองน้ำท่วม
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่เมืองเกมที่ระดับน้ำค่อยๆ สูงขึ้น ต้องหาทางขึ้นที่สูง เปิดประตูระบายน้ำ สร้างแพชั่วคราว ข้ามถนนน้ำท่วม และไปถึงหอคอยปลอดภัยก่อนเปิดทางออก
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous flood escape. Exact brother identities remain fixed. Water level must rise logically and never reset lower unless drain gate opens visibly. Props and raft persist until left behind.

scenes.title: น้ำเริ่มมา
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers arrive at dry town entrance; shallow water begins flowing across street ahead.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother points at rising water
scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers. Bright blocky town, shallow water only at street edge, no UI text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Gentle push toward water. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand at curb; water ankle-deep across first street; staircase to raised walkway visible left.

scenes.title: ขึ้นทางสูง
scenes.continuityStartState: Ankle-deep water across street; staircase left; brothers at curb.
scenes.mainAction: older brother leads both onto staircase

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ขึ้นข้างบนก่อน

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same ankle water and staircase. Older leads, younger follows.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow up stairs. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach raised walkway; water below now slightly higher; closed maintenance door ahead.

scenes.title: ประตูล็อก
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on raised walkway; water below rising; closed maintenance door ahead.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother finds plain lever beside door

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มีคันโยกตรงนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Same walkway and closed door. Younger points at plain lever; no readable text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger hand reaches lever; older waits beside door; water remains below walkway.

scenes.title: เปิดประตู
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger hand on lever; older by closed door.
scenes.mainAction: younger pulls lever and door opens
scenes.imageDescription: Same lever and door. Lever changes once; door slides open, water state unchanged.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close lever then pan to opening door. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Door fully open; both face maintenance corridor; water visible below behind them.

scenes.title: ห้องระบายน้ำ
scenes.continuityStartState: Door open; brothers stand at corridor entrance.
scenes.mainAction: they enter control room and spot large wheel valve

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: น่าจะลดน้ำได้

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers enter through still-open door; one large valve wheel ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into room. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both beside valve wheel; older grips left side, younger grips right side.

scenes.title: หมุนวาล์ว
scenes.continuityStartState: Both gripping opposite sides of valve wheel.
scenes.mainAction: they rotate wheel together one full turn

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: พร้อมนะ หนึ่งสองสาม

scenes.imageDescription: Same valve and positions. Both push together; no duplicate hands/characters.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Valve locked open; drain pipes activate; visible street water outside begins flowing downward but not instantly disappearing.

scenes.title: น้ำลดช้าๆ
scenes.continuityStartState: Drain active; brothers exit control room through same open door.
scenes.mainAction: they observe water receding enough to reveal floating planks

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ทางเริ่มโผล่แล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same walkway. Water lower than Scene 2 but still deep; several floating planks collect near rail.
scenes.videoPrompt: Pan from brothers to lowering water. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Water stabilizes at waist-deep street level; three planks float below; ladder down is accessible.

scenes.title: เก็บแผ่นไม้
scenes.continuityStartState: Three planks float beside accessible ladder; water waist-deep below.
scenes.mainAction: older brother climbs down one level and pulls planks onto platform

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เอามาทำแพได้

scenes.imageDescription: Preserve exact water level. Older pulls three planks onto dry lower platform; younger stays above watching.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side shot across two heights. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Three planks stacked on lower platform; older beside them, younger descends ladder to join.

scenes.title: ต่อแพ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on lower platform; three planks stacked; water adjacent.
scenes.mainAction: brothers join planks into one small raft

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ผมจับด้านนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Same three planks become one simple raft visibly assembled; no extra materials appearing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close teamwork shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Finished raft floats tied beside platform; both stand ready to board; far building balcony visible across flooded street.

scenes.title: ลงแพ
scenes.continuityStartState: Finished raft tied beside platform; both ready.
scenes.mainAction: older boards first and steadies raft while younger follows

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ขึ้นทีละคน

scenes.imageDescription: Same raft and water level. Older aboard first, younger stepping aboard.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both balanced on same raft; tie released; raft points toward far balcony.

scenes.title: ลอยข้ามถนน
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on released raft aimed at far balcony.
scenes.mainAction: they use one loose pole to guide raft across

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ตรงไปอีกนิด

scenes.imageDescription: Same raft mid-street; one pole shared; far balcony closer. Water level unchanged.
scenes.videoPrompt: Parallel tracking with raft. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Raft reaches far building ledge; older holds ledge; younger prepares to step off.

scenes.title: ขึ้นระเบียง
scenes.continuityStartState: Raft touching ledge; older holding ledge; younger ready to step off.
scenes.mainAction: younger steps onto balcony, then helps older up
scenes.imageDescription: Same raft remains below balcony. Younger on balcony reaches to older; identities unchanged.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both on balcony; raft remains floating below; stairs to rooftop tower directly ahead.

scenes.title: ขึ้นหอคอย
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on balcony; stairs ahead; raft below behind.
scenes.mainAction: they climb stairs together to tower roof

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ขึ้นไปบนสุด

scenes.imageDescription: Same building geometry. Brothers climb visible staircase, older leading one step.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear upward follow. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach rooftop; waterlogged town below; emergency portal beacon inactive at center.

scenes.title: เปิด Beacon
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on rooftop beside inactive beacon.
scenes.mainAction: younger presses plain beacon switch and portal powers on

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ทางออกมาแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same rooftop. One plain switch activates beacon and portal; no readable text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close switch then widen to portal glow. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Return portal fully open; both stand side-by-side facing it; town water still visible below at drained stable level.

scenes.title: มองเมือง
scenes.continuityStartState: Portal open; both beside it; drained town visible below.
scenes.mainAction: older brother checks city once before leaving

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: น้ำลดแล้ว ไปกัน

scenes.imageDescription: Same portal and rooftop. Older looks over town, younger waits by portal.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow arc from town back to brothers. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both turn together toward portal; older left, younger right, ready to enter.

scenes.title: หนีสำเร็จ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both side-by-side facing portal on rooftop.
scenes.imageDescription: Same canonical brothers enter one portal together; no teleport before entry.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into portal. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal closes after both pass; rooftop and town state remain behind; episode complete.
